content.title: Why Is Ryde Stock Soaring Friday?
content.summary: Ryde Group (NYSE:RYDE) stock gained on Friday after it announced that the NYSE American had accepted its plan to regain compliance with the exchange's continued listing standards. On May 21, 2025, NYSE American notified the Singapore-based mobility and quick commerce technology platform that it fell short of the NYSE American Company Guide, which applies to companies with less than $4 million in stockholders' equity and losses in three of the past four fiscal years.
